rationale: The customer's stack trace ends at ObjectMapper.readValue (jackson-databind) and a JDK BigDecimal constructor, but the uncaught java.lang.ArithmeticException actually escapes two repositories down, in jackson-core's big-decimal text parser. At tag jackson-core-2.13.4 the parse routine catches only NumberFormatException; the recursive big-decimal construction can also throw ArithmeticException on extreme-exponent input, which then propagates unhandled all the way to the ingestion worker. The real fix (jackson-core commit a9e3fddad0, released in 2.14.0) widens the catch in BigDecimalParser.parse to 'ArithmeticException | NumberFormatException' so malformed numeric text is reported as a normal parse error. The databind-side files are the traversal that leads an investigator across the repo boundary: NumberDeserializers.BigDecimalDeserializer calls JsonParser.getDecimalValue(), StdDeserializer._parseBigDecimal is the shared helper, and both route into jackson-core's NumberInput -> BigDecimalParser.

required_files.rationale: Fix site: parse() catches only NumberFormatException at 2.13.4; the recursive big-decimal construction can throw ArithmeticException, which escapes uncaught. Real upstream fix (commit a9e3fddad0) widens the catch here.
parseBigDecimal() is the core number-text helper that hands the field characters to the recursive big-decimal parsing routine; the bridge from the databind accessor into the throwing code.
BigDecimalDeserializer.deserialize handles decimal-typed fields and calls JsonParser.getDecimalValue(), crossing from databind into jackson-core's parser.
Shared _parseBigDecimal helper used by the scalar deserializers; part of the databind-side traversal into the core number parser.
